---
title: "Examples"
---

Multi-layer, map-backed visualizations using real public datasets. Each example downloads live data, builds layers, and renders an interactive deck.gl map.

## Global Flight Routes

Airline routes between the world's 40 busiest airports from the OpenFlights database, rendered as great-circle arcs with labeled airport markers on a dark basemap.

**Layers:** ArcLayer, ScatterplotLayer, TextLayer | [View source](examples/global-flight-routes.qmd)

<iframe src="examples/global-flight-routes.html" width="100%" height="500" style="border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"></iframe>

## Tokyo Region Earthquakes

USGS seismic data (2020--2024, M1.5+) near Tokyo aggregated into extruded 3D hexagonal bins colored by density.

**Layers:** HexagonLayer | [View source](examples/tokyo-earthquakes.qmd)

<iframe src="examples/tokyo-earthquakes.html" width="100%" height="500" style="border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"></iframe>

## London Buildings 3D

Real building footprints with heights from OpenStreetMap in the City of London financial district, extruded to actual height and colored by elevation.

**Layers:** PolygonLayer | [View source](examples/london-buildings-3d.qmd)

<iframe src="examples/london-buildings-3d.html" width="100%" height="500" style="border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"></iframe>

## Paris Trees

5,000 trees managed by the City of Paris shown as a height-weighted heatmap overlaid with individual tree points.

**Layers:** HeatmapLayer, ScatterplotLayer | [View source](examples/paris-trees.qmd)

<iframe src="examples/paris-trees.html" width="100%" height="500" style="border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"></iframe>

## UK Road Accidents

~140,000 personal injury road accidents aggregated into an extruded 3D grid over central London.

**Layers:** GridLayer | [View source](examples/uk-road-accidents.qmd)

<iframe src="examples/uk-road-accidents.html" width="100%" height="500" style="border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"></iframe>

## Australia / Indo-Pacific Earthquakes

2024 M4.5+ earthquakes across the Indo-Pacific with magnitude-colored scatter points, hexagonal density bins, and monitoring station arcs.

**Layers:** ScatterplotLayer, HexagonLayer, ArcLayer | [View source](examples/australia-earthquakes.qmd)

<iframe src="examples/australia-earthquakes.html" width="100%" height="500" style="border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"></iframe>

## US Fire Hotspots

Near real-time satellite fire detections (NASA FIRMS, VIIRS NOAA-20, 7-day window) as a fire-radiative-power-weighted heatmap with city reference labels.

**Layers:** HeatmapLayer, ScatterplotLayer, TextLayer | [View source](examples/us-fire-hotspots.qmd)

<iframe src="examples/us-fire-hotspots.html" width="100%" height="500" style="border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"></iframe>
